question: Among healthcare providers whose practice location is in Mountain View, CA, and who have a specified specialization in the field healthcare provider taxonomy, identify the top 10 most common specializations based on the count of distinct NPIs. Then determine which of those top 10 has a count of distinct NPIs closest to the average count across those 10 specializations.
sql:
WITH specialization_counts AS (
  SELECT t.specialization, COUNT(DISTINCT n.npi) as distinct_npi_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nppes.npi_optimized` n
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nppes.healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_set` t
    ON n.healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_1 = t.code
  WHERE LOWER(n.provider_business_practice_location_address_city_name) = 'mountain view'
  AND n.provider_business_practice_location_address_state_name = 'CA'
  AND n.healthcare_provider_primary_taxonomy_switch_1 = 'Y'
  AND n.healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_1 IS NOT NULL
  AND n.healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_1 != ''
  AND t.specialization IS NOT NULL
  AND t.specialization != ''
  GROUP BY t.specialization
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT specialization, distinct_npi_count
  FROM specialization_counts
  ORDER BY distinct_npi_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(distinct_npi_count) as avg_val FROM top10
)
SELECT 
  t.specialization,
  t.distinct_npi_count
FROM top10 t, avg_calc a
ORDER BY ABS(t.distinct_npi_count - a.avg_val) ASC
LIMIT 1
